chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from the one who mentioned it, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Aban ibn Taghlib, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:

You should say: 'O Allah, I ask You, and the servants do not ask like I ask You. I ask You by the right of Muhammad, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, and Ibrahim, Your friend and Your elite, and Musa, Your speaker and Your whisperer, and Isa, Your Word and Your Spirit.'

And I ask You by the Parchments of Ibrahim, and the Torah of Musa, and the Psalms of Dawud, and the Evangel of Isa, and the Quran of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and by every Revelation You Revealed, and every Judgment You Passed, and right You Fulfilled, and rich one You Enriched, and straying one You Guided, and begging one You Gave to.

And I ask You by Your Name which You placed upon the night, so it turned dark, and by Your Name which You placed upon the day so it shone, and by Your Name which You placed upon the earth so it settled and the skies were underpinned by it so (became) upheld, and placed it upon the mountains, so were anchored.

And by Your Name by which the sustenance are Sent with, and I ask You by Your Name by which the dead are revived with, and I ask You by the Bond of the Might from Your Throne and the limit of the Mercy from Your Book.

I ask You that You should Send Salawat upon Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad and that You should Grace me the memorisation of the Quran, and the varieties of the knowledge, and that You affirm it in my heart and my hearing and my sight, and that You mingle it with my flesh and my blood and my bones and my brain, and that You Utilise by it my night and my day by Your Mercy and Your Power, for there is neither Might nor Strength except with You. O Living! O Eternal!'
He said, 'And in another Hadith there is an addition:'
'And I ask You by Your Name by which Your servants supplicate with so it is Answered for them, and Your Prophets, so it is Forgiven for them and there is Mercy upon them.'

'And I ask You by every Name You Revealed in Your Book, and by Your Name which Your Throne is stabilized, and by Your Name, the Single, the One, the Individual, the Solitary, the Exalted which Fills up the corners, all of them, the Immaculate, the Clean, the Blessed, the Holy, the Living, the Eternal, Light of the skies and the earth, the Beneficent, the Merciful, the Greatest, and Exalted, and Your Revealed Book with the Truth, and the Perfect Words of Yours, and Your Perfect Light, and by Your Magnificence and Your Elements.'

And he said in another Hadith: 'Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The one who wants Allah Mighty and Majestic should Cause him to retain (memorise) the Quran and the Knowledge, so let him write this supplication in a clean container with white honey, then wash it with rain water before it touches the ground, and drink it for three days upon the empty stomach, for it would make him memorise that, Allah Willing'.
ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for memorizing the Quran and how is it performed?
ai.summary: This supplication from Al-Kafi emphasizes the intercessory power of the 'Haqq' (rights) of the prophets and the potency of Allah's unique names, particularly those associated with creation and sustenance. It is accompanied by a distinctive ritual practice of writing the text in pure honey and drinking it to facilitate the retention of the Quran and sciences, reflecting the Shia tradition of linking spiritual remedies with physical means.
